link.note: Tree shows her as wife of 'James M Tuthill' and mother of Capt. John Tuttle. Research (McCurdy p14551; deep-dive report; Alva Tuttle) shows Hannah Reeve married Joshua Tuthill, James's brother; James married Rachel Browne. Not John's ancestor (she is the wife of a 8th-great-grand-uncle).

summary: Tree error: wife of Joshua Tuthill, not of James; not an ancestor.

bio: Akerly (1898): Hannah, daughter of Maj. James Reeve of Mattituck, was the wife of Joshua Tuthill (b. 1690, d. 2 June 1782) of Cutchogue. She died 8 Mar 1764, aged 64 ([R4-S1]). She was not the wife of James Tuthill, as the tree has it.
